floor-closet.note: The Closet's floor: pale maple boards (block 0, 11), its plain seamless tile repeated to one 32 px cell. Lighter than the Bedroom's honey planks, so a closet off a bedroom reads as its own room (D-093).

floor-mudroom.note: The Mudroom's floor: grey slate tiles with light grout (block 2, 13), its plain seamless tile repeated to one 32 px cell. A hard-wearing entry floor, unlike the Bathroom's blue tiles.

floor-playroom.note: The Playroom's floor: lavender tiles like a foam play mat (block 2, 8), its plain seamless tile repeated to one 32 px cell. No other room has a purple floor, so it isn't mistaken for the Living Room.

face-bedroom.note: The north wall face of a bedroom (teal and sand diamonds on lilac): the wall block at [0, 0]'s middle tile column, its top 6 rows of wallpaper under the band, then its last 2 rows (the baseboard and the outline along the floor), repeated to one 32 px cell. The house draws it under each north wall (the audit prototype's 8 px stub); the band itself is drawn from the wall mask.
